Momentum Human Rig is an anatomically-inspired parametric full-body digital human model developed at Meta. It includes: A parametric body skeletal model; A realistic 3D mesh skinned to the skeleton with levels of detail;A body blendshape and pose corrective model; A facial blendshape model. Its design is friendly for both CG and CV communities.

Compiler-based safety checker for GPU kernels. It lowers the real compiler's IR into a small kernel IR and decides specs in Lean 4 (bounds, hangs, exactly-once writes, barrier protocol, races) with no hand-written model. Specs and frontends plug in independently; today Triton/TLX and CuTe DSL on NVIDIA Blackwell.

Repository push dates are not publication dates or evidence of a new algorithm.

A transport200 response without a valid parsed HTML link inventory is incomplete, not an empty directory. Raw compressed response hashes are preserved separately from decoded hashes.
